component.name: GarageLog
component.summary: Fuel, maintenance and cost tracking for your vehicles
Tanken, Wartung und Kosten für deine Fahrzeuge

description.p: GarageLog keeps a local, private logbook for your cars, motorcycles and scooters: fuel-ups with consumption, service history with attachments, maintenance intervals with due reminders, and cost statistics. No account, no cloud, one SQLite file you own.
